summary: Unfold over 𝖴∖G₁(𝔰); on each 𝖴-orbit the support of φ is contained in a box of frame coordinates of side R, whose volume gives (2R)^{2(ϱ+1)²}.

steps.lean: grw [← lintegral_orbitMeasure_lintegral (ν := 𝔰.besselHaar), ← lintegral_const_mul]; gcongr with y
steps.claim: ∫_{G₁(𝔰)} φw = ∫_{𝖴∖G₁(𝔰)} ∫_𝖴 φ(uy)w(uy) du dμ(y) (unfolding); it suffices to bound the inner integral, for each y, by K(2R)^{2(ϱ+1)²}·w(y).
w(uy) = w(y) for u ∈ 𝖴 ⊂ 𝖲 (hwU); pull w(y) out.

steps.lean: by_cases! e : ∀ u : besselU, φ (u.1 * y) = 0; simp [e]
steps.claim: If φ(uy) = 0 for every u ∈ 𝖴 the inner integral vanishes; otherwise fix u₀ ∈ 𝖴 with φ(u₀y) ≠ 0.

steps.lean:
rw [lintegral_mul_const, ← lintegral_mul_right_eq_self _ e.choose, Shape.besselHaar,
    lintegral_map, lintegral_prod, ← setLIntegral_eq_of_support_subset
    (s := .pi ⊤ fun _ ↦ Metric.closedBall 0 R) fun x c p _ ↦ (not_forall.1
    (c ∘ lintegral_eq_zero_of_ae_eq_zero ∘ .of_forall)).elim fun u _ ↦ ?_]
steps.claim: Translate by u₀ (the measure on 𝖴 is right invariant), write it as the image of dx·du' under (x, u') ↦ u'·liftUnitri(x), and restrict the x-integral to the box of x with all |x_{ab}| ≤ R: outside it the integrand vanishes (step 7).

steps.lean:
simp [mul_assoc]; grw [h, setLIntegral_const, mul_assoc]; gcongr; simp (disch := finiteness)
    [volume_pi, pow_mul, ← ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal]
steps.claim: Bound the inner integral over 𝖴⁰ by K (h) and integrate the constant over the box: its volume is (πR²) to the number of entries above the diagonal of a (ϱ+1)×(ϱ+1) matrix.

steps.lean:
simpa [frameMatrix_mul, liftUnitri_mem_besselU, mem_besselU0_iff.1, unitriMatrix, p.2] using
    hR _ e.choose_spec _ (mul_mem u.2.1 (liftUnitri_mem_besselU x)) (by simp_all [mul_assoc]) p.1.1
    p.1.2; repeat fun_prop
steps.claim: The support claim: if φ(u'·liftUnitri(x)·u₀y) ≠ 0, then hR applied to the points u₀y and s = u'·liftUnitri(x) ∈ 𝖴 bounds the entries of frameMatrix(s) by R; and frameMatrix(s) = unitriMatrix(x) (u' ∈ 𝖴⁰ has frame matrix 1), so every |x_{ab}| ≤ R.
